title: Save/bless path ignores pause-window stability violations, contradicting its own 'never bless a broken pause' contract
detail: The stability check appends to fails in both modes, but harness save blesses the manifest and returns true without inspecting fails — a moving paused window gets blessed, contradicting the in-code 'never bless' contract.
recommended_fix: In run_demo, before the save branch, fail the save (return false, print fails) when len(fails) > 0, so a stability violation blocks blessing instead of surfacing only on the next run.

title: pause.dem T2 comment claims a crisis-banner countdown that does not exist and misstates the post-resume frame
evidence:
# 80000ms = post-resume: the parallel standard pipe is in the bundle AND the
# SAME crisis is still active (the window did not advance during the pause —
# the crisis banner's countdown is exactly where the
# pause left it).
detail: draw_crisis_banner renders only title + redesign text (no countdown), and by 80000ms the sim legitimately advanced 200 post-resume ticks, so the window is not 'where the pause left it'.
recommended_fix: Reword to: 'the same crisis is still active (its window advanced only post-resume — none during the pause); the banner strip is pixel-identical to the frozen frame.'
